The B-tree header is also always >= 4 bytes. Let me look at the H5SMcache.c (shared message) and H5FScache.c (free space) callers:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 && sed -n '160,180p' src/H5SMcache.c && echo "---" && grep -n "H5SM__cache_table_get_initial_load_size\|H5SM__cache_table_get_final_load_size" src/H5SMcache.c | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
